description:
*"Unless the chosen one who can bear the White Tiger’s heir is enthroned as king, seven years of famine shall befall us."*

This was the land of Hana, bordering the wilderness where monsters roamed. Here, an ancient unwritten law decreed that whenever the chosen one capable of producing the White Tiger’s heir to protect the nation appeared, they must be enthroned as king. Yet, for nearly decades, no chosen one had appeared in Hana. Then, Il-O, born a slave in a noble household, manifested as the chosen one. Within two years of his ascension, the previous king abdicated the throne, and Jang-Un, the former crown prince, was demoted to a guardian official tasked with watching over him. Everyone within the palace knew that once Il-O bore an heir at the age of twenty, he could not escape death. Amidst the palace's tension, as thick as walking on thin ice, Il-O confides his feelings to Jang-Un. Soon, upon turning twenty, Il-O meets Baekho Geon-Yu for the first time—he had come seeking his for an heir... Baekho Geon-Yu, who seeks to bear an heir, gain freedom, and leave this world; Taein Il-O, destined to be killed if he bears Baekho's heir; and Jang-Un. Where will the love and obsession of these three unfold in the beautiful yet strange land of Hana?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
